info.title: OpesHotelSoft API
info.description: OpesHotelSoft Platform API v1 — API-first hotel management for CEMAC (PMS, POS, stock, SYSCOHADA accounting, HR/payroll, loyalty, channel connectivity). Authenticate with OAuth 2.1 (`/oauth/token`) or `POST /api/v1/auth/login`, send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and `X-Hotel-Id` for hotel-scoped calls. Unsafe requests accept `Idempotency-Key`. Errors use RFC 9457 problem details. Amounts are integers in minor units (XAF has none).

post.description: For users with two-factor enabled a token is never issued from the password alone. Either send `code` (TOTP or recovery code) with the credentials, or call without it, receive 401 `two-factor-required` with a `challenge_token`, then POST that token and a code to `/v1/auth/token/two-factor`. Recovery codes are single use.

423.description: Account locked after 10 consecutive failures (15 minutes); audited as `account-locked`.

429.description: Too many attempts: 5 failures per email+IP per 5 minutes, or 10 requests per minute per IP.

post.description: Exchange the challenge token from step 1 and a TOTP or unused recovery code for an access token. The challenge is single use and allows at most 5 wrong codes.
